headline: IIFL Capital submits Letter of Offer for Kronox Lab Sciences open offer
hook: Formal exit terms for Kronox Lab shareholders
summary: IIFL Capital Services has submitted the formal Letter of Offer to the public shareholders of Kronox Lab Sciences. This document contains the specific pricing, timeline, and instructions for the ongoing open offer. Shareholders can use these details to decide whether to tender their shares to the acquirer. The submission to the exchange marks a mandatory procedural step under SEBI takeover regulations.
whats_next: Opening and closing dates of the tendering period to be announced
why_it_matters: Shareholders can now review formal terms to tender their shares
winners_losers: Exiting shareholders gain / No clear losers

headline: Kronox Lab Sciences files financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
hook: September results declared by Kronox Lab
summary: Kronox Lab Sciences Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This regulatory filing provides the latest data on the company's financial performance during the quarter. Indian retail shareholders can review these figures to assess the company's revenue and profit trends.
why_it_matters: Quarterly numbers reveal the company's recent operational performance.

headline: Kronox Lab Sciences reports outcome of board meeting
hook: Routine board meeting update from Kronox Lab
summary: Kronox Lab Sciences Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges regarding the outcome of its board meeting held on October 14, 2026.
